cmd: ls -la /app && cat /app/main.tex
read_file /app/input.tex
read_file /app/synonyms.txt
cat /app/input.tex
cat /app/synonyms.txt
cd /app && which pdflatex && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > /tmp/build.log 2>&1; grep -n "Overfull" /tmp/build.log | head -50
cd /app && which pdflatex && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > build.log 2>&1; grep -n "Overfull" build.log | head -60
cd /app && grep -n -A3 "Overfull" build.log | head -60
cd /app && grep -n "curious natures\|unsought\|riotous\|responsiveness\|temperament\|wisdom\|pathfinder" input.tex

cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
orig = open('input.tex').read()
subs = [
 ('curious', 'odd'), ('unsought', 'unwanted'), ('riotous', 'wild'),
 ('responsiveness', 'sensitivity'), ('temperament', 'disposition'),
 ('wisdom', 'knowledge'), ('pathfinder', 'pioneer'),
]
for o,n in subs:
    assert re.search(r'\b'+o+r'\b', orig)
    orig = re.sub(r'\b'+o+r'\b', n, orig)
open('input.tex','w').write(orig)
EOF
pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > build.log 2>&1; grep -n "Overfull" build.log; echo "overfull-count: $(grep -c Overfull build.log)"

cd /app && which python perl node; sed -i -e 's/\bcurious\b/odd/g' -e 's/\bunsought\b/unwanted/g' -e 's/\briotous\b/wild/g' -e 's/\bresponsiveness\b/sensitivity/g' -e 's/\btemperament\b/disposition/g' -e 's/\bwisdom\b/knowledge/g' -e 's/\bpathfinder\b/pioneer/g' input.tex && grep -c "odd\|unwanted\|sensitivity\|disposition\|knowledge\|pioneer" input.tex
cd /app && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > build.log 2>&1; grep -n -A2 "Overfull" build.log; echo "overfull-count: $(grep -c Overfull build.log)"

cd /app && sed -i -e 's/\bunsought\b/uninvited/g' -e 's/\bdisposition\b/character/g' -e 's/\bknowledge\b/insight/g' input.tex && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > build.log 2>&1; grep -n -A2 "Overfull" build.log; echo "overfull-count: $(grep -c Overfull build.log)"

cd /app && sed -i -e 's/\bunwanted\b/uninvited/g' input.tex && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > build.log 2>&1; grep -n -A2 "Overfull" build.log; echo "overfull-count: $(grep -c Overfull build.log)"

cd /app && for c in unwanted uninvited unrequested undesired spontaneous; do sed -i "s/uninvited/$c/g" input.tex; pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > build.log 2>&1 | grep -o "Overfull \\\\hbox ([0-9.]*pt too wide) in paragraph at lines 5--6" | head -1; echo "  -> $c"; done

cd /app && for c in unwanted uninvited unrequested undesired spontaneous; do sed -i "s/uninvited/$c/g" input.tex; pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > build.log 2>&1; echo "  -> $c : $(grep -A1 'Overfull' build.log | grep 'confidences\|were' )"; done

cd /app && sed -i 's/\bunwanted\b/uninvited/g' input.tex && for c in unwanted uninvited unrequested undesired spontaneous; do sed -i "s/uninvited/$c/g" input.tex; pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > build.log 2>&1; echo "  -> $c : $(grep -A1 'Overfull' build.log | grep 'were')"; done

cd /app && sed -i 's/\buninvited\b/uninvitedX/g' input.tex; grep -o "were un[a-z]*" input.tex; for c in unwanted uninvited unrequested undesired spontaneous; do sed -i "s/uninvitedX/$c/g" input.tex; pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > build.log 2>&1; echo "  -> $c : $(grep -A1 'Overfull' build.log | grep 'were')"; done
cd /app && grep -n "unwanted" input.tex | head; grep -n "confidences" input.tex | head

cd /app && perl -i -pe 's/\bunwanted\b/ZZZMARKZZZ/g' input.tex && grep -o "were ZZZMARKZZZ" input.tex && for c in unwanted uninvited unrequested undesired spontaneous; do perl -i -pe "s/ZZZMARKZZZ/$c/g" input.tex; pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > build.log 2>&1; echo "  -> $c : $(grep -A1 'Overfull' build.log | grep 'were')"; done
cd /app && grep -o "were [a-z]*" input.tex; ls -la input.tex

cd /app && perl -i -pe 's/ZZZMARKZZZ/spontaneous/g' input.tex; grep -o "were [a-z]*" input.tex; pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > build.log 2>&1; grep -n -A1 "Overfull" build.log; echo "count: $(grep -c Overfull build.log)"

cd /app && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > build.log 2>&1; grep -n -A1 "Overfull" build.log; echo "count: $(grep -c Overfull build.log)"
